summary: PLAN_ID=toolchain-workflow-repair; CLI requires repository-root, plan-dir, out, skill-input-receipt; canonical output is implementation-authorization-receipt.successor.v1.json; contract plan_id and output path must match; initial state must be plan-ready with authorizes=[plan-ready]; authorized refresh requires explicit flag, matching authorizes, and predecessor receipt; refresh snapshots predecessor exclusively under repair/round-1; skill receipt must reside inside plan and validate ready against quick-dev-tdd-adapter contract; receipt binds contract, registries, context, validation, closure, candidate, validators, predecessor, and skill-input generation; generation_root and candidate_binding_hash use canonical hashing; state/resume transition to implementation-authorized and next_action=run-slice; decision owner=maintainer and reason=explicit-maintainer-authorization; authorization excludes completion, acceptance, publication, bootstrap review, and release; report is appended and pass JSON printed; source contains malformed/redacted predecessor_authorization entry, making the shown snapshot invalid Python and leaving that receipt field ambiguous; state files are updated before receipt/report, so failures can leave partial transition.
